detailed_description:
Photosensitivity Warning

This game contains flashing lights and visual effects that may trigger seizures for players with photosensitive epilepsy. Discontinue if you experience dizziness or discomfort. Play in a well-lit room and take regular breaks.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 7 32/64-bit / Vista 32/64 / XP
  • Processor: Pentium 4 3.0GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card with 128 MB, Shader model 2.0. ATI X800, NVidia 6600 or better
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows® 7 32/64-bit / Vista 32/64 / XP
  • Processor: Intel core 2 duo 2.4GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video Card Shader model 3.0. NVidia 7600, ATI X1600 or better
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c compatible sound card

short_description: Unlock your inner Dinosaur within this little adventure game! Hunt, Gatherer and Explore your way around this small Prehistoric Island.
